title: Climate zones of World
intro: Name the Koppen-Geiger climate class of each city in the world. The class is read from a 1 km map for the city's location.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Minneapolis, United States of America have?
choices: Cwa: Temperate, dry winter, hot summer
Aw: Tropical, savannah
BWk: Arid, desert, cold
Dfa: Cold, no dry season, hot summer
questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Minneapolis lies in class Dfa: Cold, no dry season, hot summer.
